candidate_daemon.command: CARGO_BUILD_JOBS=8 CARGO_TARGET_DIR=<isolated-target> bash scripts/build-lock.sh cargo build --locked --release --bin rustbgpd

native_provenance_source_fields: The native driver records its frozen e9 checkout as git source; those fields identify the driver/helper/checker, not the candidate daemon. Candidate runtime source/build is separately bound above.
thresholds: Unchanged membership-1 gates, including zero health failures and rejection of ConnectionReset warnings.
